scope: Bounded primary-document screening for PAPER-01; not a systematic literature review or executable comparison.
method: Read official project documentation and project-author announcements through web browsing. Record section locators and summaries; no competitor software execution.
release_basis: numgeo tutorial URL is versioned 2026-09; other URLs are floating documentation or dated announcements, not pinned executable releases.
limitations: No absence claims from undocumented features.
No current-service availability, performance, numerical-equivalence or novelty conclusions.
No comprehensive model/data repository coverage or independent review.
Web content was not archived byte-for-byte; these are dated reading notes, not immutable source receipts.
